items.description: Landlord must not take actions regarding the Common Area that unreasonably interfere with Tenant's access to or permitted use of the Tenant Space.
items.span_text: provided that Landlord will not take any actions with respect to such Common Area that will unreasonably interfere with Tenant’s access to the Tenant Space or the use of the Tenant Space for the Permitted Use

items.description: Landlord must use commercially reasonable efforts to complete the New Pathway Installation before the Commencement Date.
items.span_text: Landlord agrees to use commercially reasonable efforts to cause the New Pathway Installation to be completed prior to the Commencement Date.

items.description: If the New Pathway Installation is late, Tenant receives a daily Base Rent abatement as its sole remedy for each day after the Deadline Date until completion.
items.span_text: In the event that the New Pathway Installation is not completed on or prior the Deadline Date, Tenant shall receive, as Tenant’s sole remedy therefor, one-quarter (1/4) day’s abatement of Base Rent for each day following the Deadline Date until the New Pathway Completion Date occurs.
items.trigger: In the event that the New Pathway Installation is not completed on or prior the Deadline Date

items.anchor_event: completion of the New Pathway Installation
items.description: Landlord must deliver the New Pathway Completion Notice to Tenant when it completes the New Pathway Installation.
items.span_text: Landlord agrees to deliver the New Pathway Completion Notice to Tenant upon Landlord’s completion of the New Pathway Installation.

items.description: Landlord must use commercially reasonable efforts to complete the Card Reader Installation before the Commencement Date.

items.anchor_event: then applicable expiration date of the Term
items.description: To extend the Term, Tenant must deliver an Extension Option Exercise Notice to Landlord at least six calendar months before the then-current expiration date.
items.span_text: Tenant may exercise each Extension Option only by delivering an Extension Option Exercise Notice to Landlord at least six (6) calendar months prior to the then applicable expiration date of the Term

items.description: Tenant must pay Base Rent to Landlord in monthly installments in advance on the first day of each calendar month during the Term.
items.span_text: All Base Rent shall be paid to Landlord in monthly installments in advance on the first day of each and every calendar month throughout the Term of this Lease

items.description: Tenant must pay the Installation Fee to Landlord no later than the thirtieth day after receiving an invoice.
items.span_text: Tenant shall pay the Installation Fee to Landlord, no later than the thirtieth (30th) day following receipt of an invoice therefor.
